intent: Static-only utility that inspects, and optionally force-touches, how much of a file is resident in the OS page cache, used to pre-warm a database file into memory; adapted from Doug Hoyte's third-party VMTouch tool.

objects.name: VMTouch
objects.role: Static-only class; check() reports and optionally forces page-cache residency for a file path

objects.name: VMTouch::check
objects.role: Open/mmap/mincore/touch/report pipeline for one path, optionally touching pages in parallel across worker threads

objects.name: VMTouch::bytes2pages
objects.role: Rounds a byte length up to a page count

objects.name: VMTouch::isPageAligned
objects.role: Checks a pointer's alignment against the system page size

objects.name: VMTouch::is_mincore_page_resident
objects.role: Tests the residency bit of one mincore() output byte

objects.name: VMTouch::do_nothing
objects.role: No-op sink used only to keep a per-thread counter variable read as used

misfits.why: A generic, Bedrock-agnostic OS/filesystem utility living at the repo root rather than under libstuff with the rest of the reusable helpers

name_fit.note: Name matches the upstream tool it's adapted from and its contents

location_fit.note: Standalone at repo root instead of libstuff, where similarly generic helpers live

naming_quality.note: Mixes camelCase (isPageAligned, bytes2pages) with snake_case (is_mincore_page_resident, do_nothing)

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::MAX_SIZE_QUERY/MAX_SIZE_BLOB/MAX_SIZE_SMALL
objects.role: Size limits enforced so the storage engine cannot silently truncate oversized input

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::isValidDate
objects.role: Regex-based date/datetime format validator

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::verifyAttributeInt64/verifyAttributeSize/verifyAttributeBool/verifyAttributeDate
objects.role: Throw a 402 on missing or malformed request attributes

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::getCommand
objects.role: Factory that claims a request into a BedrockCommand or declines it by returning null

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::getInfo/getName/upgradeDatabase/initializeFromDB/timerFired/getPort/onPortAccept/onPortRecv/onPortRequestComplete/preventAttach/onDetach/onAttach/stateChanged/onNodeLogin/serverStopping/shouldLockCommitPageOnConflict
objects.role: Overridable lifecycle hooks a plugin implements as needed; most default to no-ops

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::g_registeredPluginList

objects.name: BedrockPlugin::timers

misfits.why: Purely static helpers that operate only on an SData request with no dependency on BedrockPlugin state or the plugin lifecycle; read like generic request-validation utilities rather than plugin-system code
misfits.suggested_home: libstuff/SData.h or a new shared request-validation unit

location_fit.note: Core plugin-system header at repo root alongside BedrockServer, matching class_hierarchy.md's Bedrock-specific layer

naming_quality.note: Consistent on-prefixed event callbacks and a single clearly-named global (g_registeredPluginList)

intent: RAII scoped lock keyed by an opaque uint64_t identifier (a commit-conflict key), backed by a shared, refcounted, LRU-pruned pool of mutexes so concurrent commands only block each other when they collide on the same identifier.

objects.name: ConflictLockGuard
objects.role: RAII guard; constructor blocks until the mutex for its identifier is held, destructor releases it; identifier == 0 is a no-op

objects.name: ConflictLockGuard::controlMutex
objects.role: Guards all access to the shared mutex-pool bookkeeping

objects.name: ConflictLockGuard::mutexes
objects.role: The pool: identifier to mutex map

objects.name: ConflictLockGuard::mutexCounts
objects.role: Reference counts per identifier, used to decide what's safe to prune

objects.name: ConflictLockGuard::mutexOrder/mutexOrderFastLookup
objects.role: LRU order over identifiers plus an index into it, used to prune the pool once it exceeds MAX_PAGE_MUTEXES

objects.name: ConflictLockGuard::_identifier
objects.role: The identifier this instance locked, or 0 for a no-op guard

name_fit.note: Accurately a lock guard, though it locks on an arbitrary identifier, not specifically a 'conflict' per se

location_fit.note: Fits alongside BedrockConflictManager and BedrockServer, which is its only caller

naming_quality.note: Private static members (controlMutex, mutexes, mutexCounts, mutexOrder, mutexOrderFastLookup) lack the repo's leading-underscore convention that _identifier follows; the constant MAX_PAGE_MUTEXES and its comments call the keyed value a 'page' though the class and its only caller call it a 'conflict key'

intent: Thread-safe collector that tracks how often each command name touches which database tables during commit conflicts, and renders a plaintext profiling report.

objects.name: BedrockConflictManagerCommandInfo
objects.role: Per-command tally: a total count plus a table-name to use-count map

objects.name: BedrockConflictManager
objects.role: Mutex-guarded collector; recordTables() tallies one command's table touches, generateReport() renders a plaintext summary

objects.name: BedrockConflictManager::recordTables
objects.role: Increments a command's total and per-table use counts, skipping journal* tables and json_each

objects.name: BedrockConflictManager::generateReport
objects.role: Renders one text block per command with its total and per-table counts

name_fit.note: Exactly what it says: manages conflict statistics

location_fit.note: Fits alongside BedrockServer, which is its only expected user, and ConflictLockGuard

naming_quality.note: Private mutex `m` breaks the repo's leading-underscore convention for private members, while `_commandInfo` right below it follows it

intent: Defines the VERSION macro reporting the running build's git revision (from GIT_REVISION, passed in by the Makefile), or a placeholder if none was supplied.

objects.name: VERSION
objects.role: Build-revision string, consumed by main.cpp (--version) and BedrockServer's _version field

objects.name: STRINGIZE/EXPAND_STRING
objects.role: Private stringizing helpers used only to expand GIT_REVISION into VERSION

name_fit.note: A Bedrock-specific version macro, named accordingly

location_fit.note: Small config-style header at repo root alongside its consumers (main.cpp, BedrockServer.cpp)

naming_quality.note: Name and purpose closely shadow version.h's SVERSION, inviting confusion between a live macro (VERSION) and an apparently dead one (SVERSION)

intent: Defines a fallback SVERSION macro (a placeholder 40-character hash); unlike bedrockVersion.h's VERSION, this macro is not referenced by any other file in the repo.

objects.name: SVERSION
objects.role: Placeholder all-zero revision-string macro

misfits.why: SVERSION is never included or referenced anywhere else in the repo (only bedrockVersion.h's differently-named VERSION is actually used); appears to be dead code superseded by bedrockVersion.h

name_fit.note: Generic name collides conceptually with bedrockVersion.h's VERSION; having both invites picking the wrong one

location_fit.note: Sits at repo root as if in active use, but appears to be an unreferenced leftover

naming_quality.note: Carries the repo's `S` shared-utility prefix though it's an unused macro, not a libstuff type

objects.name: main

objects.name: GREEN/RED/RESET/BOLD

objects.name: SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE_THRESHOLD
objects.role: Percent-change cutoff used to classify a result as improved/regressed vs. unchanged

objects.name: g_benchmarkResults
objects.role: Name-to-BenchmarkResult map shared across the whole benchmark binary; defined in main.cpp

objects.name: BenchmarkBase
objects.role: Mixin base class holding the owning fixture's name

objects.name: BenchmarkBase::setup/teardown
objects.role: Overridable hooks run around each runBench() call

objects.name: BenchmarkBase::runBench
